g.text: Prepare-Doc - SigLIP 2 NAFlex Phased Training Schedule
Backbone stays frozen for all 4 phases.
Only task heads and loss weights change.
Activate G1 (IQA, 6 heads) + G2 (Script, 1 head) only
All G3/G4/G5 heads frozen — zero loss weight
sigma_k is a learnable per-head parameter.
G1 loss stable < 10% delta over 2 epochs?
PCGrad detects conflicting gradients between head groups.
For heads i and j where g_i dot g_j < 0:
Projects the conflicting component to zero
Kendall uncertainty weighting per head (all groups)
Cosine LR schedule with warmup (first 3 epochs)
Early stopping: patience=10 on composite primary metric
If budget exhausted → proceed to Phase 4
Boost failing head loss weight x2
Reduce LR 10x from Phase 3 final LR
Flag failing heads for dataset expansion
Register checkpoints in GCS model registry
